activity.instructions: Complete each sentence with one word or phrase from the box: reluctant, sustainable, commute, scrutiny, cut back on, ensure.
items: My ______ to the office takes almost an hour by bus.
Many people are ______ to change banks, even when fees are high.
The new law will face close ______ from the public.
We need a more ______ way to use water in the dry season.
I am trying to ______ coffee because I sleep badly.
Please ______ that all windows are closed before you leave.
